verdict.rationale: Mistral says OCR 4 can run in a single container in your own environment, keeping document data local for residency and sovereignty. Its Document AI page also offers secure on-premises deployment for compliance-first organizations, so residency control comes through self-hosting rather than a documented choice of hosted region. Missing for 10: documented region selection on the hosted API/La Plateforme, details of where hosted data is stored and how long it is retained, independent or hands-on confirmation of the self-hosted residency setup.
